Class LessonsLearned

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.LessonsLearned
public class LessonsLearned extends Object

Title: LessonsLearned

Description: Entity class that models a single "lesson learned" record. A lesson is written by a contributor and consists of an author, a title, a body of text, and a database-assigned ID. Two lock flags (title and description) allow a curator to prevent the original author from editing the corresponding field.

Instances of this class mirror one row of the lessons table in the database (columns: id, author, title, text, isTitleLocked, isDescriptionLocked). This class does not itself perform validation; see ModelCreateLesson.validateTitle(String) and ModelCreateLesson.validateText(String).

  • Constructor Details

    • LessonsLearned

      private LessonsLearned()
      Default constructor. It is private and intentionally unused so that a lesson cannot be created without at least an author, title, and text.

    • LessonsLearned

      public LessonsLearned(String author, String lessonTitle, String lessonText, entityClasses.Category category)
      Creates a new lesson that has not yet been stored in the database. The ID is left at its default value (0) because it is generated by the database when the lesson is inserted, and both lock flags default to false.
      Parameters:
      author - the username of the contributor who wrote the lesson
      lessonTitle - the title of the lesson
      lessonText - the body text of the lesson
      category - the category of the lesson

    • LessonsLearned

    • LessonsLearned

      public LessonsLearned(String author, String lessonTitle, String lessonText, int lessonID, boolean isLessonLocked)
      Creates a lesson with its database ID specified. This is used when reading an existing lesson back from the database, where the ID is already known. Both lock flags default to false.
      Parameters:
      author - the username of the contributor who wrote the lesson
      lessonTitle - the title of the lesson
      lessonText - the body text of the lesson
      lessonID - the unique ID assigned to the lesson by the database
      isLessonLocked - true if the lesson is locked
